title: Correction: Evaluation of the safety of live attenuated influenza vaccine (LAIV) in children and adolescents with asthma and high-risk conditions: a population-based prospective cohort study conducted in England with the Clinical Practice Research Datalink.
ehr_evidence: The study protocol was approved by the CPRD Independent Scientific Advisory Committee (ISAC; protocol 14_062) and registered at ENCePP (EUPAS18527).
summary: This correction notice addresses errors in a previously published population-based prospective cohort study evaluating the safety of live attenuated influenza vaccine (LAIV) in children and adolescents with asthma and high-risk conditions using the Clinical Practice Research Datalink.
population: children and adolescents with asthma and high-risk conditions in England
limitations: None explicitly stated in the correction text; the correction addresses protocol approval and reference citations rather than study limitations.
data_availability_statement: The study protocol was approved by the CPRD Independent Scientific Advisory Committee (ISAC; protocol 14_062) and registered at ENCePP (EUPAS18527).
